name: How do small-space planning services differ from traditional interior design?

mainEntity.name: How do small-space planning services differ from traditional interior design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small-space planning services are hyper-focused on maximizing efficiency and multi-functionality within extremely limited square footage, a primary concern for tiny homes. Traditional interior design, while also focusing on aesthetics and function, often has more flexibility with space and can prioritize decorative elements more heavily. Small-space planning emphasizes innovative storage solutions, convertible furniture, and strategic layouts to ensure every inch is utilized effectively, whereas traditional design might have fewer constraints in these areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small-space planning prioritizes extreme efficiency and multi-functionality in limited spaces, unlike traditional interior design which has more spatial flexibility.
